channel.title: Nate’s Substack
channel.description: Daily newsletters on AI strategy, news, and implementation for practitioners and leaders who are past the hype and ready to build.

channel.googleplay:author: Nate

item.title: Your customers won't ask for Gemini 4 Argon. Their best AI product idea probably isn't in their feature requests either. Four questions surface the work they gave up on.
item.description: It’s a phenomenal time to build with AI and a good place to start is with the person whose life you can make better.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: Executive Briefing: Agents Split Your Software Into 3 Parts. Which Should You Keep Paying For?
item.description: Agents are pulling apart the data, screens, and workflows you’ve been buying as one subscription. Each piece now needs its own decision.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: Hitting your ChatGPT limit? Try Sol before paying $300 more
item.description: Used together, Dots, Space, and Sol turn the context you've built with AI into a shared workspace. The questions to ask are what can it take on and what does that work cost?

item.title: Only Allowed Copilot? 5 Habits I'd Build That Carry to the Next Model
item.description: The best AI isn’t always employer approved. These are the habits I’d build with the approved tools you have, starting with one prompt you can run this week.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: Does your work cost less on Opus 5.5 now that its tokens are 20% cheaper? My 3-prompt guide shows which jobs do before you move them.
item.description: Anthropic heard the complaints about Opus 5. Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 are both easier to steer, and both make even complex jobs cheaper to run.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: What are you still paying for that you meant to cancel? I handed mine to an AI assistant: $1,285 a year cancelled so far. The prompt guide for the tedious part of yours.
item.description: A canceled subscription is the beginning. Meta’s new assistant points toward a much larger change in who does the work of managing your life—and who gets to sell you things along the way.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: Executive Briefing: You Bought Better Tools and Your Finished Work Still Waits
item.description: AI is making some people dramatically more productive. Getting that speed through the rest of the organization is a separate problem, and it isn’t solved by making the fast people teach everyone else.
item.dc:creator: Nate

item.title: Inside NVIDIA: What a world model actually is, and how it connects to the LLM you already use.
item.description: A conversation with NVIDIA’s Cosmos lead about the next expansion of AI: what world models do, how they connect to LLMs, and the strategic choices that matter as AI learns to act.
item.dc:creator: Nate
